name: rate-limit-this
title_zh: 审完滥用面才动手写限流契约的代码审计员
tagline_zh: Next.js 接口裸奔上线前，它先盘出所有可被刷的入口，只问你策略问题。
tagline_en: Before your Next.js routes go live naked, it maps every abusable entry, asks only policy questions, drafts.
desc_en: Audit a JavaScript or TypeScript web app, especially Next.js, for abuse and rate-limit surfaces, ask the human only material policy questions, write a root RATE_LIMITS.md for review, and implement the approved limits in the same context or a fresh agent. Invoke manually to design fair usage policies, choose protections suited to the existing stack, or implement a reviewed rate-limit contract.
why_zh: 把「限流」从拍脑袋加中间件，变成先审计后立约的工程流程；策略问题问人，实现问题自己查。
why_en: Turns rate-limiting from guesswork into an audited contract: policy questions go to humans, implementation details it digs up.
limit_zh: 只审计 JS/TS 与 Next.js 栈；不自动部署，只产出 RATE_LIMITS.md 和代码改动。
limit_en: JS/TS & Next.js only. No auto-deploy; outputs RATE_LIMITS.md plus code edits. Skip policy Q&A and it refuses, falling back to audit mode.
title_en: Audit abuse surfaces, then write a rate-limit contract for.
